name: nodepuls
description: NodePuls — homelab monitoring dashboard (v2 rewrite: Vue 3 + Vite + TS client, Express + TS server)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=@nodepuls/server" "npm run dev --workspace=@nodepuls/client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@nodepuls/client && npm run build --workspace=@nodepuls/server && node scripts/copy-build.js
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@nodepuls/client && npm run typecheck --workspace=@nodepuls/server
